pages.text: Besides the seven FLORA fluids, fluid armor takes **any fluid with an armor effect**: water, lava, Fieldframe's own fluids and every molten Metallurgy metal. Fill it in an **Armor Infuser** like the others. Each fluid gives its effects on its own once the four worn pieces together hold enough of it (summed, usually 1,000 mB); some grow a level per extra amount. All fluids share the piece's capacity, so mixing trades strength for variety. **Cleanse** removes harmful effects every few seconds. The armor's tooltip shows what is active.

**This list is data.** Each file in data/<pack>/fieldframe/fluid_armor_effects/ lists entries such as fluid minecraft:lava, effect minecraft:fire_resistance, with optional amplifier, min_mb, mb_per_level and max_amplifier. A fluid may be a #tag; any mob effect id works. KubeJS: FieldframeEvents.fluidArmor. JEI lists every entry under **Fluid Armor**.
